title.en: Fable 27 — The Milkmaid and Her Pail

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A girl walked from the farm to the market.

sentences.ar: היא נשאה דלי חלב על הראש.
sentences.en: She carried a pail of milk on her head.
The morning was beautiful and the road long.
She walked slowly and thought to herself.

sentences.ar: היא אמרה: אני אמכור את החלב.
sentences.en: She said: I shall sell the milk.
She said: and with the money I shall buy eggs.
She said: from the eggs there will be chicks.
She said: and the chicks will grow fast.

sentences.ar: היא אמרה: אני אמכור אותם בשוק.
sentences.en: She said: I shall sell them at the market.

sentences.ar: היא אמרה: ואני אקנה לי שמלה חדשה.
sentences.en: She said: and I shall buy myself a new dress.
She said: and I shall go with it to the party.

sentences.ar: היא אמרה: וכל הבחורים יבואו אליי.
sentences.en: She said: and all the young men will come to me.

sentences.ar: היא אמרה: ואני לא אסכים לרקוד.
sentences.en: She said: and I shall not agree to dance.

sentences.ar: היא אמרה: אני רק אזיז את הראש.
sentences.en: She said: I shall only move my head.

sentences.ar: היא הזיזה את הראש בדיוק ככה.
sentences.en: She moved her head exactly like that.

sentences.ar: הדלי נפל, והחלב נשפך על הדרך.
sentences.en: The pail fell, and the milk spilled on the road.

sentences.ar: אל תספור מה שעוד לא קרה.
sentences.en: Do not count what has not yet happened.
